sn54.2:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ: ānāpānasati bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
sn54.2:1.2: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave, ānāpānasati kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
sn54.2:1.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu ānāpānasatisahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ
sn54.2:1.5: ānāpānasatisahagataṃ upekhā sambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn54.2:1.6: evaṃ bhāvitā kho bhikkhave, ānāpānasati evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsāti.
